paper_settlement_requires_fill.name: paper_settlement_requires_fill
paper_settlement_requires_fill.value: "pickler"."paper_orders"."settlement" IS NULL OR ("pickler"."paper_orders"."status" = 'filled' AND "pickler"."paper_orders"."fill" IS NOT NULL)

paper_pending_lease.name: paper_pending_lease
paper_pending_lease.value: "pickler"."paper_orders"."status" <> 'pending' OR ("pickler"."paper_orders"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "pickler"."paper_orders"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

running_requires_lease.name: running_requires_lease
running_requires_lease.value: "pickler"."runs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("pickler"."runs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "pickler"."runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

preview_running_requires_lease.name: preview_running_requires_lease
preview_running_requires_lease.value: "pickler"."preview_runs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("pickler"."preview_runs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "pickler"."preview_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

advice_lease.name: advice_lease
advice_lease.value: "pickler"."advice_jobs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("pickler"."advice_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null AND "pickler"."advice_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

ai_credit_ledger_deltas.name: ai_credit_ledger_deltas
ai_credit_ledger_deltas.value:
("billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'purchase' AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."balance_delta_units" > 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."reserved_delta_units" = 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."purchase_id" is not null) OR
    ("billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'reserve' AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."balance_delta_units" = 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."reserved_delta_units" >= 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."operation_id" is not null) OR
    ("billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'settle' AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."balance_delta_units" <= 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."reserved_delta_units" <= 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."operation_id" is not null) OR
    ("billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'release' AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."balance_delta_units" = 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."reserved_delta_units" <= 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."operation_id" is not null) OR
    ("billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."reserved_delta_units" = 0 AND "billing"."ai_credit_ledger"."balance_delta_units" <> 0)

transaction_requests_included_has_hash.name: transaction_requests_included_has_hash
transaction_requests_included_has_hash.value: "launch"."transaction_requests"."status" not in ('included', 'finalized') or "launch"."transaction_requests"."tx_hash" is not null

pools_locator.name: pools_locator
pools_locator.value: "market"."pools"."address" is not null or "market"."pools"."pool_key" is not null

tokens_launched_consistent.name: tokens_launched_consistent
tokens_launched_consistent.value: "market"."tokens"."status" not in ('pre_graduation', 'graduated') or ("market"."tokens"."address" is not null and "market"."tokens"."launched_at" is not null and "market"."tokens"."total_supply" is not null and "market"."tokens"."quote_decimals" is not null)

perps_checks_lease.name: perps_checks_lease
perps_checks_lease.value: "pickler"."perps_checks"."status" <> 'running' OR ("pickler"."perps_checks"."lease_owner" is not null AND "pickler"."perps_checks"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

perps_owner_actions_target.name: perps_owner_actions_target
perps_owner_actions_target.value: ("pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."kind" = 'close') = ("pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."position_id" is not null) AND ("pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."kind" = 'approve') = ("pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."proposal_id" is not null)

perps_owner_actions_lease.name: perps_owner_actions_lease
perps_owner_actions_lease.value: "pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."status" <> 'running' OR ("pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."lease_owner" is not null AND "pickler"."perps_owner_actions"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
